name: Teletronix LA-2A Leveling Amplifier
description: Teletronix Division of Babcock Electronics Corp. Model LA-2A Leveling Amplifier (schematic S-1014-1 M, 12-21-65, rev. 7-13-66, with 11-66 S/N 572+ Limit/Compress slope switch addendum): UTC HA-100X 600:60k input transformer (T1) -> R5 68 kOhm secondary termination -> R6 68 kOhm + R7 2.7 kOhm / SW2 Limit-Compress bridge + T4A/T4B CdS photoconductive gain-reduction cell -> R1 100 kOhm Gain pot -> V1 12AX7A two-stage voltage amplifier (R9/R13 220 kOhm, R10 1.5 kOhm, R14 2.7 kOhm) -> V2 12BH7A White cathode follower totem-pole line stage (R17 10 kOhm current-sense plate, C3 0.1 uF push-pull drive to lower grid, R18/R20 1 kOhm) with 20 dB overall negative feedback (R21 100 kOhm, R22 33 kOhm || C4 HF trim, R11 68 kOhm to V1a cathode) -> C5 10 uF parafeed coupling into UTC A-24 15k:600 output transformer (T2). Feedback sidechain: R2 100 kOhm Peak Reduction pot -> paralleled V3 12AX7A control amplifier (R33 220 kOhm, R31 1 kOhm || C8 0.03 uF, R32 1 kOhm) -> C9 0.02 uF -> R37 1 MOhm || C12 0.001 uF Limit Response pre-emphasis driving C6 0.01 uF + R30 47 kOhm and R3 1 MOhm Stereo Adjust -> V4 6AQ5A luminescent driver pentode (R34 22 kOhm, R35 220 kOhm / C7D 30 uF, R36 1 kOhm || C10 50 uF) -> C11 0.01 uF + R8 2.2 MOhm into T4B electroluminescent panel; NE-2 65 V regulated second T4B CdS meter bridge.

sources.title: Teletronix Div. of Babcock Electronics Corp., 'Instruction Manual: Leveling Amplifier Model LA-2A' (3-66, schematic S-1014-1 M rev. 7-13-66, and 11-66 S/N 572+ Limit/Compress switch addendum), Library of Congress Recording Preservation collection
Universal Audio, Inc., 'Model LA-2A Leveling Amplifier User's Guide' (LA2A-M01 Rev. 1.3, Figs. 5-7 schematics and theory of operation)
RCA Electron Tube Division datasheets: 12AX7A High-Mu Twin Triode, 12BH7A Medium-Mu Twin Triode, and 6AQ5A Beam Power Tube (250 V Class A1 characteristics and direct interelectrode capacitances)

United Transformer Corp. (UTC) catalog specifications for HA-100X (600:60k Hipermalloy input) and A-24 (15k:600 plate-to-line parafeed output) transformers; Sowter Type 1009 / 1010 replacement inductance data
Headroom Wave C device research section 4 (Alfrey-Taylor electroluminescent panel law and bimolecular CdS photocell with trap/history memory)

12BH7A.note: 12BH7A twin triode fitted (Headroom 2026, tools/circuit/tube_fit.py) to the RCA 12BH7-A 'Average Plate Characteristics, Each Triode Unit' (92CM-7742R1, 1955; 495 points, data in work/tube-curves/12BH7A) with the triode law's contact-potential offset vgo: RMS error, % of 50 mA, 11.7 -> 1.4 (Va < 50 V 2.0 -> 0.6) against the previous hand-fitted card; 250 V / -10.5 V gives gm 3.2 mA/V (sheet 3.1), rp 5.9k (5.3). RCA unshielded capacitances Cgk=3.2 pF, Cgp=2.6 pF, Cpk=0.5 pF

6AQ5A.note: RCA 6AQ5A 7-pin miniature beam power tube (electrically equivalent to 6V6GT up to 250 V): fitted to RCA 250 V / -12.5 V Class A1 point (Ia=45.0 mA, Ig2=4.5 mA) with RCA 6AQ5A direct interelectrode capacitances (Cin=8.0 pF, Cg1p=0.4 pF, Cout=8.5 pF)

T4B_CELL.note: unverified: Clairex CL-505L CdS cell in Teletronix T4A/T4B module fitted to published LA-2A system specifications (ron=400 Ohm -> 40 dB max GR behind R6+R7=70.7 kOhm; gamma=0.75 with T4B_EL b=20 -> ~3:1 Compress slope; kr=55 s^-1 -> ~9 ms full-light attack and ~55 ms to 50% release; tau_h=2.5 s, mr=2.5 -> 0.6 s short release to ~4 s heavy-compression release)

controls.label: Gain
controls.note: Front-panel R1 100 kOhm audio-taper makeup Gain potentiometer feeding V1a grid (up to 40 +/- 1 dB system gain)

controls.label: Peak Reduction
controls.note: Front-panel R2 100 kOhm audio-taper Peak Reduction potentiometer feeding V3a/V3b sidechain grids

controls.label: Mode
controls.note: SW2 leveling slope switch (S/N 572+ 11-66 addendum): 0 = Compress (~3:1 pure feedback across T4A pin 7, R7 bypassed to sidechain), 1 = Limit (infty:1 horizontal limiting with R7 2.7 kOhm feedforward bridge active)

controls.label: Limit Response
controls.note: Rear-panel R37 1 MOhm Limit Response HF pre-emphasis rheostat (shunted by C12 0.001 uF into C6 0.01 uF + R30 47 kOhm): 0 = flat clockwise factory studio setting, 1 = full 1 MOhm FM broadcast pre-emphasis (+10 dB more sensitivity at 15 kHz vs <= 1 kHz)

controls.label: Stereo Adjust
controls.note: Rear-panel R3 1 MOhm Stereo Balance potentiometer feeding V4 6AQ5A grid; factory standalone setting is full clockwise (1.0)

controls.label: HF Feedback Trim
controls.note: Internal C4 50-380 pF NFB phase-lead / HF flatness trimmer across R22 33 kOhm (~165 pF default for +/-0.1 dB to 15 kHz)

controls.label: Meter Zero
controls.note: Front-panel R4 1 MOhm VU meter zero-adjust rheostat in the NE-2 regulated T4B meter bridge

controls.label: Dry
controls.note: Hardware LA-2A has no parallel dry blend path

controls.label: Sidechain
controls.note: External sidechain insert flag (not present on original LA-2A)

controls.label: VU Mode
controls.note: Front-panel meter selector switch (1: Output +10, 2: Gain Reduction, 3: Output +4)

controls.label: VU Meter
controls.note: Read-only legacy VU meter telemetry alias

gr.note: The front-panel VU in Gain Reduction: the second T4B photocell (T4A_MTR, lit with the gain cell) in the NE-2 regulated R4/R25/R26/R27 meter bridge. Zeroed at the no-signal operating point like R4 Zero Adjust; 20*log10(v_rest/v) reads within 1.5 dB of the gain taken off from 0 to 15 dB (test_circuit_unit).
